items.title: 12.12.3 Odorants and fragrances (boo aur khushboo wali cheezen) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 12.12.3, printed page 284.

blocks.text: Natural gas ko boo dene ke liye is mein mercaptans milaye jate hain. Kuch thiols bohat halke (dilute) hon to achhi khushboo dete hain; masalan thioterpineol grapefruit ki khushboo ka asal ingredient (juz) hai. cis-galbanum oxathiane (kitab mein 'glabanum') ek khushboodar compound hai jo fine fragrances (umda khushbuon), sabun, shampoo aur shower gel mein istemal hota hai. Bohat si natural (qudrati) khushbuen ab factory mein (synthetically) banai jati hain aur flavouring agents (zaiqa dene wali cheezon) mein bhi istemal hoti hain.

blocks.prompt: Natural gas, jo khud odourless (be-boo) hai, mein mercaptans kyun milaye jate hain?
blocks.explanation: Methane ki koi boo nahi, is liye leak ka pata nahi chalta. Teez boo wale mercaptan ki thori si amount (miqdar) se leak ki boo foran aa jati hai, aur gas ke khatarnak had tak pohnchne se pehle hi pata chal jata hai.

items: Mercaptans natural gas ko boo dete hain; thioterpineol grapefruit ki khushboo; oxathiane fragrances mein; bohat se odorants synthetic aur flavouring mein.
